title: Agreement on an initial bit segment
statement: For Boolean sequences $A,B,C$ and a natural number $i$, the agreement indicator at $i$ equals true if and only if $C_j$ equals the $j$th sum bit of $A$ and $B$ for every $j<i$.
hypotheses_covered: $A,B,C$ are Boolean sequences indexed by the natural numbers
